posts.title: Data Centres And Water Scarcity
posts.description: Vizag and Google’s data centres have been all over my feed this week. Data centres in India use only about 0.02% of the country’s water. That figure is accurate. It is also useless, and both sides of this argument keep reaching for it. One camp quotes it to end the conversation. posts.title: Chitty Kampany
posts.description: Chitty Kampany turns a Google Sheet into a chit-fund management app - a phone-based collection screen instead of paper registers, and a live, auditable ledger instead of reconciling notebooks by hand.
